record.original_question: For all ranks r and degrees d, is the Quot scheme Quot^r_d(A^2) reduced?

evidence.quote: Problem II. Is the Quot scheme Quotr_d(A^2) reduced for all r, d?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, and let $\mathbb{A}^2 = \operatorname{Spec} k[x,y]$ denote the affine plane over $k$. For positive integers $r$ and $d$, let
$$\operatorname{Quot}^{r}_{d}(\mathbb{A}^2)$$
denote the Quot scheme parametrizing isomorphism classes of quotients
$$\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{A}^2}^{\oplus r} \twoheadrightarrow \mathcal{Q}$$
where $\mathcal{Q}$ is a coherent sheaf on $\mathbb{A}^2$ of finite length $d$ (a zero-dimensional quotient of length $d$). Equivalently, this scheme parametrizes submodules $M \subseteq k[x,y]^{\oplus r}$ such that $k[x,y]^{\oplus r}/M$ has dimension $d$ as a $k$-vector space.

Determine whether the scheme $\operatorname{Quot}^{r}_{d}(\mathbb{A}^2)$ is reduced for every choice of positive integers $r$ and $d$.
artifact.status_search_result: The reducedness of the Quot scheme of points on the affine plane for all ranks r and lengths d appears to be open. Existing work (e.g., ADHM-type descriptions of Quot schemes of points on affine spaces) establishes irreducibility and reducedness in special cases but does not settle the full question. The classical case r=1 corresponds to the Hilbert scheme of points on the smooth surface, which is known to be reduced, but the general rank-r statement is not known.

status_evidence.title: A note on the ADHM description of Quot schemes of points on affine spaces
status_evidence.snippet: We prove new properties concerning irreducibility and reducedness of these Quot schemes and their punctual versions ... in some special cases of higher r and c.
status_evidence.claim: Reducedness is established only in special cases, not for all r and d.

status_evidence.title: The Hilb-vs-Quot conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Conjectural relationships between Hilbert schemes and Quot schemes of points on surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related structural questions about Quot schemes of points remain active research topics.
